title: ScMap whose keys u32 1 and symbol "1" collide after native conversion
description: A valid, host-ordered SCV_MAP with two entries whose keys have different ScVal types but the same printed form. Converting the map to a native dictionary keyed by strings loses one entry unless the SDK detects the collision.

shapes.note: The host requires sorted, duplicate-free keys; it does not care how keys print.

provenance.method: Encoded from XDR-JSON with the stellar-xdr CLI.
provenance.rationale: Hand-built because it is a bare ScVal, not ledger output. Keys are in host order (u32 before symbol), so any contract can return or emit this map; the js-stellar-sdk changelog for #1778 states the same. A ledger entry carrying it in a contract event is planned as a local-core companion.

operations.why: The conversion must keep both entries or fail; it must not return one entry.

notes: Same map as the reproduction in the issue. Both verdicts were measured on 2026-11-17 with the published npm packages (repro/README.md): v17.2.1 returns { "1": 20 }, one entry and no error; v17.3.0 throws.
